content.label: Examiner note - mass language
content.body: 'Relative atomic mass' and 'mass number' are NOT interchangeable. Mass number belongs to ONE isotope (protons + neutrons, a whole number); Ar is the weighted mean for the ELEMENT. In 'explain why Ar of chlorine is 35.5', the marking points are: chlorine exists as isotopes AND abundance-weighted mean - '35.5 neutrons' scores nothing.
